candidates.excerpt: A group of North Dakota ranchers who spent nearly $300,000 fighting a pipeline company over land compensation have taken their dispute over legal expenses to the US Supreme Court. Although they reached a settlement, an appeals court ruled that the company need not cover their legal costs. The Supreme Court will hear the case on November 9.

candidates.title: Two Drug Peddlers Arrested in Bachupally; MDMA, Ganja Seized
candidates.excerpt: The Telangana EAGLE Force has apprehended two alleged drug peddlers in Bachupally, Cyberabad, and seized MDMA, ganja and other articles. Police are investigating their alleged supply network and identifying customers who purchased narcotics from them.

candidates.title: India’s Zorawar light tank faces protection and performance trade-off
candidates.excerpt: India's Zorawar light tank program is facing a critical design challenge in upgrading protection without sacrificing mobility. The Indian Army requires stronger armour to resist more powerful ammunition and threats. Development is ongoing by the Defence Research and Development Organisation and Larsen & Toubro, with an expected service entry around 2028-2029. A phased approach might help balance initial production with future upgrades for protection.
